# Contentsquare

> > Contentsquare is an AI-powered experience intelligence platform that combines analytics, session replay, and customer feedback to optimize digital experiences and drive conversions.

Contentsquare provides an all-in-one suite of tools for understanding and optimizing customer experiences across web and mobile. The platform integrates advanced AI capabilities, including the Sense Analyst agent, with traditional analytics methods like session replay, heatmaps, and surveys to deliver actionable insights.

## Key Topics

- Sense Analyst AI
- Session Replay
- Experience Analytics
- Product Analytics
- Conversation Intelligence
- Voice of Customer
- Heatmaps
- Journeys
- Smart Capture

## Core Platform & Products

- [Contentsquare: all-in-one experience intelligence platform](https://contentsquare.com): AI-powered experience intelligence platform for analytics and insights
- [Experience Analytics: Increase Engagement and Conversions](https://contentsquare.com/platform/experience-analytics): Experience Analytics product for user behavior tracking and optimization
- [Product Analytics: Track Multi-Session, Cross-Device Journeys](https://contentsquare.com/platform/product-analytics): Product Analytics for multi-session journey tracking and conversion
- [Conversation Intelligence: Analyze Your Customer Conversations](https://contentsquare.com/platform/conversation-intelligence): Conversation Intelligence for analyzing customer and AI-handled interactions
- [Voice of Customer (VoC): Feedback for Better Decision-Making](https://contentsquare.com/platform/voice-of-customer): Voice of Customer product for AI-powered surveys and user testing
- [Web Analytics: Acquire and Retain More Customers](https://contentsquare.com/platform/web-analytics): Web Analytics for customer journey and marketing channel analysis
- [Experience Monitoring: Improve Site and App Performance](https://contentsquare.com/platform/experience-monitoring): Experience Monitoring for performance optimization and error analysis

## AI & Advanced Capabilities

- [Contentsquare AI: Smarter and Quicker Analytics for All](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/ai): Sense Analyst AI capabilities for automated data analysis
- [Faster insights into your Contentsquare data. Directly from your favourite AI agent.](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/mcp-server): MCP integration for ChatGPT, Copilot, and AI agent connectivity
- [Contentsquare Launches AI Agent & ChatGPT Analytics Platform](https://contentsquare.com/press/new-ai-agent-and-analytics-capabilities): Announcement of Sense Analyst AI agent and ChatGPT integration

## Visualization & Insight Capabilities

- [Session Replay: Reveal What Customers Experienced](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/session-replay): Session Replay capability for visualizing user interactions and pain points
- [Contentsquare Heatmaps: Visualize How Your Content Performs](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/heatmaps): Heatmaps capability for visualizing user clicks, hovers, and scrolls
- [Journeys: Visualize Customer Journeys From Start to Finish](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/journeys): Journeys capability for visualizing customer progression and drop-offs
- [Smart Capture](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/smart-capture): Smart Capture for automatic, retroactive user interaction data collection
- [Surveys: Effortlessly Collect and Analyze User Feedback](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/surveys): Surveys capability with AI-powered analysis and feedback collection

## Data & Integration

- [Data Connect: Connect your data. Multiply your insights.](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/data-connect): Data Connect for exporting to Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks
- [Mobile Capability: Make More of Your Mobile Experience](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/mobile): Mobile analytics and optimization capabilities for apps and devices
- [Find the right Contentsquare Tech Partner](https://partners.contentsquare.com/technology-partners): Technology partner directory for Contentsquare integrations
